externalEvidenceScope.rule: Open-source mechanisms are classified from current source/official docs; closed managed-service internals are not inferred beyond public product contracts. The cross-harness matrix is descriptive and not a quality score.

frozenDecisions: The provisional 20-node list expands to Core-24 because Atomicity Gate requires Context Projection, Completion Contract, Checkpoint/Branch/Recovery, and Plugin/Skill/Tool/MCP boundaries to remain distinct.
Agent Plugins portable core remains upstream-defined; Ordivon does not create a rich portable Plugin schema.
Agent Skills, Tool surfaces, and MCP are orthogonal capability surfaces and must not be collapsed into one interface.
Runtime remains the physical execution substrate; Agent Service remains semantic/control-plane authority; Harness remains the model/context/action loop.
Artifact Version and Artifact Observation remain separate identities; future Ordivon Artifact work should evaluate a generic ProducerRef rather than binding provenance only to scientific Cells.
Research-side development records remain evidence and are not relabeled as current-main authorities until separately integrated.
The catalog is a reference vocabulary, not a requirement to migrate production code or implement all 24 LEGO.
